verdict.rationale: Blaxel is an agent-hosting platform, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair axis for it. The evidence only documents hosting remote MCP servers and exposing each sandbox as an MCP server, which are server-side roles. Nothing shows Blaxel or its hosted agents acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers and uses their tools, so the hosting capability is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
